Pojoaque Pueblo

Pojoaque is a distinct Tewa Pueblo in northern New Mexico. Its language department and tribally operated Poeh Cultural Center offer starting points into community-led teaching, art and cultural preservation.

03

Learning Téwa across generations

Pojoaque dates its language department’s establishment to a 2018 Tribal Council resolution. Its public account describes second-language learners working with first-language speakers, developing immersion-based curriculum and training teachers. These are specific efforts and aims; the page does not establish proficiency throughout the community.

Read the sources [1] Pojoaque Pueblo

04

The Poeh as a community institution

The Poeh dates its establishment to 1988 and describes planning involving Tribal Council, artists, staff and community members. Its account brings arts teaching, archives, exhibitions and collections together. The timeline distinguishes the 1991 original museum, later buildings and the 2005 permanent collection unveiling.

Read the sources [4] Poeh Cultural Center, a center of the Pueblo of Pojoaque
